title: 주차별 매출이익 상태 의미·버튼 일관성 — 표시 전용

actions.name: PRESENT_STATUS_AND_EXISTING_ACTIONS
actions.sideEffect: Pure presentation only. Preserve existing handlers, auth, disabled/loading, confirmation and dirty/stale/abort guards. No new automatic verification, refresh, save, or SQL writes. Existing explicit verification GET stays unchanged.

criteria.notChecked: Neutral source-not-compared is not an error verdict.
criteria.usable: Only actual server verified row whose year/week/display key and dirty/stale/abort protections pass. Never infer from finite numbers or stored/confirmed status.
criteria.estimate: Explicit estimate provenance remains distinct from verification and direct blocking issues. Never certify estimated as verified.
criteria.blocking: Missing required numeric inputs => calculation unavailable; finite direct error or unknown warning => needs review. Preserve backend held and original reasons.
criteria.global: COVERAGE/STALE/global issues displayed once with per-row qualification; never label every category as proven monetary error.
criteria.noActivity: Label profit rate not applicable, not no transactions: confirmed zero sales/cost/inventory and no denominator do not disprove free movements. Missing inventory evidence and inventory-only rows are excluded. Zero denominator K null alone is not missing cost.
criteria.impact: No invented monetary impact; retain proven units or say impact unknown. Partial totals cannot appear complete.
criteria.missingCells: Render visible field name and supported cause at the null cell, not tooltip alone. Derived I/J/K explain actual missing E/F/H/rate sources rather than merely missing result. Total null explains affected country/category and field. Preserve inputs, original values, formulas and Excel output. Zero-denominator not-applicable stays distinct.
criteria.sourceLocation: Show supported menu/table/column or policy-file location. Distinguish absent SQL input, unmatched approved rule, allocation reconciliation failure and unsupported web inventory revaluation. Never claim DB missing from derived null or generic metadata alone. Duty-H null causing E/F null is a dependency, not proof ProductStock or average formula is missing. No hardcoded week43 findings or new automatic query.
criteria.diagnosticMetadataOnly: profitTemplateDuty may append display-only diagnostics at existing missing/revalue failure branches. Preserve all conditions, branch order, formulas, numeric values, nulls, statuses, original reason strings and input immutability. No SQL/API/cost reloading/cache/storage changes. Identify exact rule-key vs name/country, freight allocation conservation vs absent evidence, and actual failed revaluation prerequisites.
criteria.financialParity: Required tests compare before/after H/E/F/I/J/K/totals/null/status/original reasons with only new diagnostic metadata stripped. Include actual-shape missing cases, manual/explicit zero/no inbound/zero tariff/mixed rules/confirmed and cross-year near misses. Any numerical or verdict difference blocks release.

crossYearFixture.description: Same week in another year, stale display, dirty edit, aborted/late response cannot retain usable state; current server acceptance function unchanged.

dnspyEvidence.source: Actual local FormStockView.GetData CLI and SELECT-only 2026 38/39/43 snapshot probe. Presentation-only, ERP and web calculation/storage unchanged.
